environment.frequency_control: governor recorded; frequency and turbo are not fixed

child_environment.PATH: inherited for executable lookup; all other variables omitted

installed_build_provenance: Existing artifacts are identified by hashes; their build commands and flags are not inferred from file names

endpoints.source-order-c-output: Fresh rmd process: installed prelude read/check, root source-order read/check/evaluation, host inputs, dlopen/dlsym/libffi calls, target frontend, complete C and rename output, and cleanup; no target GCC
endpoints.prepared-c-output: Fresh prepared rmd-c process: target frontend and complete C and rename output; no host-entry preparation or target GCC
endpoints.gcc-original-syntax: Fresh GCC process: preprocessing, parsing, and semantic checks on the matched original C source

library_preparation.statistic: one preparation observation, not a median or confidence interval
library_preparation.scope: Read/check/lower all library RMD sources, emit C, GCC -O2 -fPIC -fno-semantic-interposition compilation, objcopy renaming, and shared linking; installed rmd-c and system tools are inputs
library_preparation.reason: A separate output measures a complete source-library rebuild without changing the installed input library

method.randomization: Shuffle workloads each round and all three endpoints within each workload
method.pairing: One sample for every endpoint in the same workload and round
method.bootstrap: Resample complete paired rounds; report ratio of medians and median of paired ratios separately
method.timing: perf_counter_ns around fresh process launch and completion; includes all child processes and cleanup
method.outputs: Complete C stdout and rename text go to DEVNULL; preflight preserves and compares both streams
method.cold_source_order: Each invocation reads/checks the installed prelude and root, executes ordinary host code, loads the explicit native library, and runs the target frontend; no prepared-root cache or per-action as/ld
method.prepared_inputs: Launcher, rmd-c, explicit native backend library, host runtime, and system tools already exist
method.library_preparation: Optional separate single rebuild observation; excluded from frontend samples and not combined with their confidence intervals
method.excluded: Workload generation, preflight, installed compiler construction, and final target GCC/objcopy/link execution
method.generated_c_syntax: Untimed preflight validation only; target GCC parsing, compilation, and linking are excluded from measurements
method.os_file_cache: Warm; no cache eviction; each invocation has a fresh process, evaluator, module state, and host context
method.compiler_cache: No compiler or execution-result cache; no root assembler/linker preparation
method.cpu_affinity: Controller and descendants pinned to the selected allowed CPU; CPU is not reserved
method.required_speed_gate: source-order-c-output upper 95% ratio-of-medians bound <= 1 versus GCC syntax on matched original C for every workload
method.scope: Direct intrusive witness and matched 1000/8000 ordinary functions; no whole-language or memory-safety claim

source_order_minus_prepared.scope: Difference between complete process endpoints; not isolated host-preparation phase attribution
Difference between complete process endpoints; not isolated host-preparation phase attribution
